title: Playing the festival, and never dancing
summary: Punch hopes to play the upcoming festival and says he never danced.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: What? You have to phone up somehow and get a message for your time. Yeah, we'll play it around.
If we could... You know, you're young, but you've got gray hair, huh?
Isn't that funny? She takes after me.
You got huge young, but you got gray hair. Isn't that funny? She takes after me. Uh-huh.
In 28. No. So. Um, you were going to play in the festival. And you hope to still, don't you?
That's right. I won't stay bad. I want to do it on the 22nd. I'd like to get out of there about a week and a half, of course.
Yeah, you could sing, if nothing else.
Yeah, yeah. Do something, man. Yeah. Hmm?
You could sing, or you could take a bow, or we could talk. That's what we did last time. We talked, too, you see.
Yeah. Well, we talk and play and sing and everything, right? Uh-huh. Hmm.
Did you like to dance? Dance? Or did you just like to play music?
I ain't never danced. I tried one time, but I fell down. I never tried anymore.
I guess you were always on the other side of the stage.
